notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
Cast Role Reversal by paying {U}{U}{R}, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
